text:
- **Records site views:** The site shows each record's published version beside every draft. Each draft opens as a full version with section diffs.
- **Owner question handling:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site as well as in chat. The first answer wins, and hook events close each question.
- **CI runs and checks:** The AGENTS.md check gives the same verdict on every rerun. macOS Go jobs now run daily, not on every pull request.
- **Repository setup:** Claude Code auto memory is now off in this repo. The post-checkout git hook is retired, and pm moved to its new release.
